title: Tumhari train khadi, Vande Bharat aage kyun nikli?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: Tumhari train 40 minute se khadi... Vande Bharat nikal gayi!
Control room me har train ki RANKING hai.
Upar wali pehle... tumhari side me wait.
[whispers] Vande Bharat ko 2 minute roka... controller SUSPEND!
Aise aur railway raaz... follow karo!
caption:
Tumhari train 40 minute se side me khadi... aur Vande Bharat SAAAR se nikal gayi! 😤

Raaz: railway me har train ki ek precedence (ranking) hoti hai. Control office me baithe Section Controller tay karte hain kaun si train pehle jaayegi. Upar wali train main line pe aage nikalti hai, neeche wali ko station ki side line (loop) pe rok ke wait karaya jaata hai. Vande Bharat ko aaj sabse upar ki priority milti hai, aur Rajdhani-Shatabdi bhi upar hain.

Kitni strict? April 2023 me Kerala me Vande Bharat ke trial run ke dauraan Piravom station pe ek controller ne bheed wali Venad Express ko pehle jaane diya. Vande Bharat 2 minute late hui... aur controller SUSPEND! (Union ke virodh ke baad suspension wapas liya gaya.) 🚆

Agla railway raaz kya chahiye? Comment karo 👇
